scripts.text:
[Lenneth]
I come from Valhalla to aid you.
I can transmute for you many of the Valhallen items,
although they require many rare elements to make.
scripts.translation:
[蕾妮絲]
我來自瓦爾哈拉，前來助你一臂之力。
我能為你煉製許多瓦爾哈拉的裝備，不過需要不少稀有材料。

[Lenneth]
Go on and find all these items.
I will wait here to aid you.
scripts.translation:
[蕾妮絲]
去收集齊這些材料吧。
我會在這裡等著，助你完成製作。
